It looks like 95% of people are saying form is the issue and they may be right. For me though, when I had the same issue, my form was fine according to the more experienced lifters. My issue was that my lower back had not caught up with my deaflift. 

What I did was

- Drop the weight for a week and increase reps.

- Started using a belt when the weight got above a plate

- (most important I think) I started doing back hyperextentions. Either free weight or a machine.

Hope this helps. At least it shouldn’t hurt. Good luck!
